rounds.text: Sales growth has stagnated significantly, with the trailing twelve months showing a mere 2% increase [E17], a sharp decline from the 21% five-year average [E15]. The company's valuation appears rich relative to its peers, with a price-to-book ratio of 1.58x compared to the sector benchmark of 0.74x [E7], while its return on assets of 11% lags far behind the sector's 87.38% [E8]. Investors face extreme risk as evidenced by an annualized volatility of 72.8% [E54] and a historical peak-to-trough drawdown of -93.6% [E53]. The business also suffers from a cyclical earnings profile [E58] and inconsistent operating margin trends over both the last two years and the last two quarters [E32, E33]. Institutional interest is virtually non-existent, with foreign institutions holding 0.00% and domestic institutions holding just 0.10% [E42, E43], contributing to a negative 5.2% price return over the last twelve months [E52]. Conceded: the company is almost debt-free [E60] and has delivered strong historical profit growth of 26.4% CAGR over the last five years [E61].
